facts.business: Makers Laboratories Limited markets generic formulations in the Indian market, manufactures liquid injectables on a contract manufacturing basis, and manufactures ophthalmic eyedrops for domestic and Rest of World (ROW) markets.

capacity_or_capex.item: New ophthalmic eye drops manufacturing facility at GIDC, Naroda, Ahmedabad, Gujarat
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Commercialised in the later part of financial year 2020-21

guidance_or_targets.statement: As the commercial production from this new manufacturing unit gradually increases, post commercialisation of more products for the India and ROW markets, the same shall result in improved financials of this manufacturing unit as well as that of the Company.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts (referred to as 'We' in audit report)

key_risks: Lower prevalence of acute diseases leading to lower growth in generic business
Depreciation, finance cost and overheads relating to new ophthalmic facility impacting profitability
Cut-throat competition in Indian generic formulations market
Quality issues of generics manufactured in the country
Non-existence of organised generic formulations distribution and retailing system
Competition, price realisation, changes in government policies and regulations, tax regimes and economic conditions
facts.related_party_note: The Company and its subsidiary have not given any loan or advances in the nature of loan to firms/companies in which directors are interested. The Board has approved a policy for related party transactions.
